# Pixel Word Counter

A lightweight, offline word counter that runs entirely in your browser. Type or paste text into the text area and see live counts of words, characters, and sentences, plus an estimated reading time at 200 words per minute.

## Features

- Live word, character, and sentence counts
- Estimated reading time (200 WPM)
- Clear button to reset everything
- Fully keyboard accessible with visible focus states
- Responsive layout that works from 360px wide
- No external dependencies, network requests, or server code

## Usage

1. Open `index.html` in any modern browser.
2. Start typing in the text area.
3. Counts update instantly as you type.
4. Click the **Clear** button to reset the text and counts.

## Files

- `index.html` – structure and content
- `style.css` – styling and responsive layout
- `script.js` – counting logic and event handling

## Accessibility

- Text area has a visually hidden label for screen readers.
- Live counts are announced via `aria-live="polite"`.
- All controls have hover, focus, and pressed states.
- The Clear button is focusable and activates with Enter or Space.
